scope: Prevent the concrete DXF adapter from downcasting a plain HATCH as MPOLYGON or serializing an MPOLYGON through the HATCH writer, which would omit its subtype-specific fields.

behavior: HATCH dispatch requires a DRW_Hatch runtime object and refuses DRW_MPolygon subclasses instead of discarding MPOLYGON fields.
MPOLYGON dispatch requires a DRW_MPolygon runtime object before calling the derived writer.
Both wrong-tag cases preserve an existing destination; correcting the tag permits a same-adapter retry and typed readback.

validationProfile.source: Generated locally from empty DRW_Hatch and DRW_MPolygon records, with fill ACI, annotated boundary and offset-vector values on the MPOLYGON. No drawing fixture is used or committed.
cases: DRW_MPolygon tagged as HATCH is refused, then admitted as MPOLYGON.
DRW_Hatch tagged as MPOLYGON is refused, then admitted as HATCH.
assertions: Each wrong subtype/tag pair fails without changing a pre-existing destination sentinel.
Same-adapter corrected retries import as the expected runtime type.
MPOLYGON readback retains fillColorAci, annotatedBoundary, xDirX and xDirY.

validation.focusedTestResult: PASS: 1/1; four subtype/encoding refusal and retry cases with HATCH and MPOLYGON typed readback, in 0.59 seconds.
validation.fixturePolicy: No drawing fixture was added or committed.

limitations: The controls verify adapter dispatch and modeled DXF transport only.
They do not qualify physical DWG producer profiles, MPOLYGON fill or boundary semantics, or native rendering.
No support claim is promoted; P6/P8 remain open.
